items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: We had -- one of the replacements was the name I showed you on there, Sainave.

ctx.x: Well, then, it was the same group more or less that had been in the States?

Oh, yes. I mean we probably had one or two replacements that didn't want to come over. We had -- one of the replacements was the name I showed you on there, Sainave. He was a student at the French Conservatory in Paris.
